# Get-ZbxDiscoveredHost

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the discovered hosts that network discovery found.

## SYNTAX

### All (Default)

```
Get-ZbxDiscoveredHost [-Limit <int>] [-SortField <string[]>] [-Id <ulong[]>] [-NetworkDiscoveryRule <ZabbixReference<ZabbixNetworkDiscoveryRule>[]>] [-DiscoveredService <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDiscoveredService>[]>] [-SelectNetworkDiscoveryRules] [-SelectDServices] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ById

```
Get-ZbxDiscoveredHost [-SortField <string[]>] -Id <ulong[]> [-NetworkDiscoveryRule <ZabbixReference<ZabbixNetworkDiscoveryRule>[]>] [-DiscoveredService <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDiscoveredService>[]>] [-SelectNetworkDiscoveryRules] [-SelectDServices] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByFilter

```
Get-ZbxDiscoveredHost [-SortField <string[]>] -Filter <ZabbixDiscoveredHostGetParameters> [-NetworkDiscoveryRule <ZabbixReference<ZabbixNetworkDiscoveryRule>[]>] [-DiscoveredService <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDiscoveredService>[]>] [-SelectNetworkDiscoveryRules] [-SelectDServices] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A discovered host is an address network discovery found, with when it was last up or down and the services found on it. The Get-ZbxDiscoveredHost cmdlet reads them with dhost.get: all of them up to -Limit, by id with -Id or from the pipeline, or with the whole dhost.get selection in -Filter. -NetworkDiscoveryRule and -DiscoveredService narrow the result to the discovered hosts of the objects given, each a name, an id or a piped object. It writes ZabbixDiscoveredHost objects, with their related objects when a -Select switch asks for them, or, with -CountOutput, the number of matches; it needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get the discovered hosts of a network discovery rule

```powershell
Get-ZbxDiscoveredHost -NetworkDiscoveryRule 'Local network'
```

Gets the discovered hosts of the network discovery rule Local network. -NetworkDiscoveryRule takes a name, an id or an object; a network discovery rule piped from Get-ZbxNetworkDiscoveryRule binds to it by its NetworkDiscoveryRuleId property.

### Example 2: Count discovered hosts

```powershell
Get-ZbxDiscoveredHost -CountOutput
```

Writes how many discovered hosts the server has, without reading them.
